headlines.headline: TRAIL BLAZERS LAND JA MORANT IN TRADE WITH GRIZZLIES
headlines.detail: Portland acquired former All-Star guard Ja Morant from Memphis, the offseason's biggest move yet; Draymond Green re-signed with Golden State on a one-year, $27.7 million deal, and the Wizards are among four teams talking with free agent DeMar DeRozan.

headlines.headline: JONATHAN TAYLOR SIGNS LARGEST-EVER THIRD CONTRACT FOR A RUNNING BACK IN $44M COLTS EXTENSION
headlines.detail: Taylor agreed to a two-year, $44 million extension with the Colts a day after Lions RB Jahmyr Gibbs signed his own extension; all 32 teams are in camp ahead of tonight's Hall of Fame Game between the Cardinals and Panthers.

headlines.headline: INDIANA OPENS AS PRESEASON NO. 1 IN COACHES POLL, CHASING A REPEAT NATIONAL TITLE
headlines.detail: USA Today's preseason Coaches Poll has defending champion Indiana at No. 1, with Ohio State, Notre Dame, Miami and Oregon as the top challengers heading into the 2026 season.

headlines.headline: 30 MORE ATHLETES GRANTED ELIGIBILITY AS PLAINTIFFS WIN GEORGIA 5-IN-5 LAWSUIT AGAINST THE NCAA
headlines.detail: Jamichael Stillwell (Texas Tech) and RJ Godfrey (Arizona) have landed at new schools while Chauncy Wiggins remains in the portal; ESPN also announced the field for the 2026 ESPN Events Invitational at Walt Disney World.
